213020.description:
As a mysterious girl gazes into the distant sky and a high school girl named Ichi stands still, the story follows what they will see within this devastated world and what kind of tale they will weave.

(Source: MAL News)

213052.description:
"No matter what happens, I will protect you."

Teru Kurebayashi, a high school student, starts to receive emails on the cell phone she received from her late brother Souichirou, her only relative.

The emails, sent by a mysterious figure named "Daisy," become her sole support in life following Souichirou's passing. One day, after accidentally breaking a window at school, Teru ends up working for Tasuku Kurosaki, the school custodian.

Kurosaki is sharp-tongued and works her to the bone, but for some reason, he kindly looks out for Teru. And after meeting Kurosaki, Teru's fate starts to change drastically...

(Source: Dengeki Daisy Official Site)

213066.description:
Murakami-san, a boss beloved by everyone, and his subordinate Kaji-kun, have a secret. Murakami-san is clingy and easily moved to tears, and she and her subordinate Kaji-kun are lovers. And she has a split tongue.

(Source: Getchu, translated)

213067.description:
Big Dick Next Door
Megumi, an older wife. She hasn’t had sex with her husband in a while, so her morning masturbation sessions have been getting more intense. Tsuyoshi, a college student who lives next door, rings the doorbell, comes inside, and pushes Megumi down. He rips off her clothes, presses his hard cock against her face, and starts rubbing it vigorously before forcing it into her mouth and unloading a massive load of cum. Then, as Megumi tries to escape, he grabs both her hands from behind, forces himself inside her, and cums deep inside her! That day, Tsuyoshi’s sexual appetite went on and on. The next morning, after seeing her husband off at the front door, she is suddenly hugged tightly from behind. It was Tsuyoshi standing there. Her calm, pleasant facade shatters, and her true nature—that of a woman with insatiable sexual desire—is exposed by Tsuyoshi.

(Source: Mediabank, translated)

title.native: 寝取られた爆乳妻たち2

213068.description:
The story takes place 20 years after the robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious Aposdoll. The world is now in peace. However, toy manufacturer Kasuga, who relied on its toys of merchandise of Dandivine, has fallen into decline. Thus, Kasuga's president Genjuro Shijima prayed for Dandivine's revival, and the Aposdoll suddenly returned. High school student Gekiha Shijima gets an invitation from his uncle Yusaku Kuroiwa, the former main pilot of Dandivine, to pilot the giant robot himself.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 獣王武神ダンデヴァイン

213094.description: As the daughter of the Dragon King, Kim Yong-Man has never had true independence. When her father tries to force her hand in marriage, Yong Man runs away from home, deciding to try and live a "normal" life. She enrolls in a human high school and vows to become the top student there. However, Sim Hae-Su, the current first-ranked student, isn't pleased with the appearance of a new rival, and promises himself that he'll never let her beat him. As Yong-Man and Hae-Su continue to clash at school and try to busy themselves with their studies, they somehow keep getting tangled up with each other. Will these academic opponents end up falling in love – and what could this mean for Yong Man's supernatural side?

213095.description:
During the final days of the Edo period, Jo Niijima risked his life to travel to America in search of freedom. Fortunately, with the support of many kind-hearted individuals in this new land, he was able to receive a democratic and advanced education across three different schools.

While studying abroad, Niijima realized that for Japan to become a modern nation, it was essential to have an education system that fostered individuals filled with autonomy, freedom, and a strong conscience. Upon returning to Japan, he dedicated himself to transplanting an American-style school into his homeland, taking on the challenge of establishing Japan's first private university.

Ultimately, his ambition and dream of founding a university were not realized during his lifetime. However, that dream has been continuously passed down and lives on within the students, alumni, and faculty of present-day Doshisha.

(Source: Official site, translated)

213096.description:
On a legendary island shaped like an unusually regular turd, a population of turd-people and insanely aggressive animals go about their hilarity-packed day to day lives. Central character Yoshiko Un is known as Unko-san, but you're unlikely to meet her--the island appears only to the fortunate few, to whom they give good luck.

(Source: The Anime Encyclopedia)

title.native: うんこさん ツイてる人にしか見えない妖精 純情派
title.romaji: Unko-san: Tsuiteru Hito ni Shika Mienai Yousei Junjou Ha

title.native: トミカとトム シーズン2

213099.description: A traffic safety short starring the Hana no Mahoutsukai Mary Bell cast. The short was re-released on the Hana no Mahoutsukai Mary Bell DVD-Box Set in 2009.

title.native: マリーベルの交通安全

213100.description: A fire safety short starring the Hana no Mahoutsukai Mary Bell cast. It specifically focuses on fires that start because of an earthquake and what a child should do in such a situation when they may be trapped in a building. The short was re-released on the Hana no Mahoutsukai Mary Bell DVD-Box Set in 2009.

title.native: マリーベルの火の用心　グラッときたらどうする
title.romaji: Mary Bell no Hi no Youjin: Guratto Kitara Dousuru

213101.description:
The "hyper black comedy" anime takes place in Nyagoya City, a trendy town where cats live. In this peaceful town, many of the cats are suddenly disappearing. The NEET cat Takumi must save his father, who is wrapped up in the incident. The anime will feature the characters speaking in Nagoya dialect, and will feature famous sightseeing spots such as Nagoya Castle.

(Source: Anime News Network)

213102.description:
Two seals, Eru and Aru, spend their days together in a gentle and warm atmosphere. They play at home, relax watching TV, and sometimes get tired from playing and fall asleep.

(Source: U-NEXT, translated)

title.native: あざらしのえるあーる

213106.description:
In a world where the Fiends run rampant... Magicmaster Alus Reigin, the young prodigy that has defeated more Fiends and reclaimed more of humanity’s lost territory than anyone else alive, requests retirement from military service at age 16. But due to the twists and turns of fate surrounding his status as the No. 1 Magicmaster in the nation—the top Magicmaster out of more than 100,000—he ends up as a student at a special magical institute, hiding his identity and training his successors – a pair of beautiful Magicmaster girls! Not to mention continuing to defeat Fiends in secret... Get ready—the epic adventure of the Greatest Magicmaster Alus Reigin begins now!

(Source: J-Novel)

title.native: 最強魔法師の隠遁計画

213131.description:
All sugar, no spice, and everything nice… that's the impression the beautiful first-year high schooler and "heartthrob angel" class president Otogi Katsura gives to those around her. In reality, Otogi is brash, assertive, and has no problem calling out a jerk when she sees one—the complete opposite of her soft spoken vice presidential counterpart, the equally beautiful and seemingly perfect Toki Ninomae. One day, when a group of boys try to hit on her at the train station, Otogi doesn't hold back and gives them a piece of her mind—and, to her surprise, Toki enjoys seeing this side of her. Not only that, it turns out the seemingly polite, put-together vice president has a hidden side of his own… and Otogi now finds him more attractive than ever! Now "partners-in-crime," Otogi and Toki agree to keep their hidden sides a secret from the rest of their classmates—but could this shared, dark secret also bring them closer together…?!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
213131.hashtag: #恋せよまやかし天使ども #恋ども
synonyms: Fall in Love, You False Angels

title.native: 恋せよまやかし天使ども

213164.description:
There's a rumor about a mysterious freedom fighter who wears a Korean Bridal Mask and goes around fighting injustice and dealing out righteous judgement. This mysterious Korean hero is known as "Gaksital." There lives two Korean brothers, Lee Kang-To and Lee Kang-San. Lee Kang-To serves as a Japanese police in Korea and devotedly serves and respects Japan while seemingly betraying his origins. Meanwhile his brother is a loyal Korean patriot who was beat down so severely by the Japanese police that he became mentally unstable. In order to care for his brother (and others that he holds dearly), Kang-To needs power and money. How is going to acquire recognition from the Japanese, and obtain a more powerful position? Catch the legendary Gaksital. The Gaksital and Kang-To serve as perfect foils for each other; their ideals differ. While Kang-To believes that it's right for the strong to prey on the weak because the strong worked that much harder to achieve power, the Gaksital believes in equity among all people. And so the Kang-To (Justice) vs Gaksital (Justice). Cat-and-Mouse chase begins. As truths are revealed, friendship-family ties shatter, the people of Korea rebel, and tragedies unfold, hundreds of thousands of lives are lost. And Lee Kang-To changes from the Japanese's dog, to a tragic hero of Korea. This is a tragic story of love-hate, right-wrong, patriotism, betrayal and redemption.

(Source: Sorrow)

213188.description:
In the Canglan Continent, strength is determined by martial spirits. Qin Nan, the young master of the Qin family, was originally a useless soul, suffering endless scorn. By chance, he awakened the soul of an ancient war god, thus defying fate. He swept through sect geniuses, overcame powerful enemies and obstacles, encountered a soulmate, used his battle spirit to break all laws, and forged a legend with his blood. From a humble young master, he rose through the ranks to become an invincible supreme celestial being who shakes the nine realms.

(Source: IQIYI, translated)

213297.description: In the primordial apocalypse, Xihe, a maiden of the Huihua Clan, fled the brutal rebellion in her ancestral homeland. Breaking free from the control of the Qiongming Demon Tribe, she embarks on a quest for the Demonslayer Divine Sword, igniting the War of the Six Armies.
synonyms: 云深不知梦 特别篇
Eclipse of Illusion Special: The Battle of Qiumina

title.english: Eclipse of Illusion SP: The Miasma War
title.native: 云深不知梦 特别篇：逐冥之役
title.romaji: Yun Shen Buzhi Meng Special: Zhu Ming Zhi Yi

213298.description:
Gakken's hugely popular illustrated encyclopedia series, which everyone can enjoy with its laid-back four-panel comics, is finally being adapted into a TV anime!

Discover surprising aspects and fun facts about living creatures—full of secrets that will make you say, "Wow!"

Enjoy this new kind of anime that makes even scary things fun and easy to watch, with its cute art style.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

213316.description:
In the city-state of Orihalconia, where alchemy and magic are deeply woven into everyday life, a reincarnated man named Paracelsus makes a modest living as an alchemist while concealing his powerful cheat skill.

One day, however, he forms a contract with Nora, a sorceress slave girl, and encounters Coco, an elf who has been deprived of her limbs and all of her senses. From that moment, his life begins to change dramatically.

Determined to save Coco, Paracelsus begins a small act of salvation from his humble workshop. But what starts as a personal mission soon grows into a conflict involving alchemy, sorcery, the cosmos, and even the gods themselves—

A story packed with "everything fantasy has to offer" is about to begin!

(Source: Official Website, translated)
213316.hashtag: #ニセモノの錬金術師  #ニセ錬

213317.description: Music video for the song Roman Jet Charisma. The song contains a partial parody cover of the song Rouman Hikou by Kome Kome Club, and is the theme of the 3DCG live "Charisma House Tour 2026".

213338.description:
This is a story about girls that have never left their hometown, and despite the misfortunes they face, continue to say "My hometown is the best!"

(Source: MangaUpdates)

213343.description:
Made to commemorate the 15th Anniversary of Studio MAPPA, a special animation set to the song Seikatsu by PEOPLE 1.

Note: It premiered during the "MAPPA 15th Anniversary Lineup Reveal" video on the MAPPA CHANNEL via YouTube.

213353.description:
Mafuyu, Ritsuka, Haruki, Akihiko, and Ugetsu return in a collection of short stories.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

213360.description:
“What you’re about to experience is nothing less than the living history of Rakugo.”

Inspired by her Rakugoka father, Akane Ousaki aims to become a Shin'uchi. After graduating high school, she formally joins Shiguma's school. Now known as Akane Arakawa, she takes her first steps as a Rakugoka. She arrives at Yasaka-tei, a traditional, bustling Rakugo theater. Surrounded by Shin'uchi, Akane finally begins her training at the heart of Rakugo performers. A full-fledged story of Rakugo, where master storytellers compete.

The Zenza Arc begins!

(Source: Akane-banashi Global, edited)

213362.description:
After the release of the divine artifact Shiva's Wrath, Cangnan City faces an unprecedented crisis. With the Western evil gods lurking in their wake, are the Chinese gods about to awaken? Infused with the power of the twin gods, Lin Qiye joins the Night Watchmen of Cangnan City in fighting against the Western evil gods and defending Cangnan! The Second War of the Gods is about to begin!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Slay The Gods Movie: The Dead of Cangnan

One day, as Christmas approaches, Chitose spots a puppy in town. It turns out to be Chibisuke, the puppy he had rescued and cared for after an accident. Concerned about Chibisuke, Chitose goes to check on him, only to encounter Kanna, who had been searching for Chitose, determined to claim him for herself...

(Source: Bandai Channel, translated)

"The moment the first gleam of sunlight trickled in gently stirring the folds of a shallow sleep—that was when the graffiti appeared..."

- Premiered at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival on June 10, 2025, as a part of the official selection in the Off-Limits category, where it also won the Off-Limits Award.

213369.description:
Melos runs desperately to rescue his best friend, who has been imprisoned in his place. The story depicts the deep friendship and mutual devotion between the two.

(Source: Gakken, translated, edited)

213370.description: Historical telling of Japan, with the main characters as animals, exploring the mysteries of ancient Japanese history, such as the origins of the common people's lifestyles and the formation of the ancient state.

213372.description:
Special anime produced for Nippon Television's educational program 20th Century Hour.

Depicts a young man's journey towards his lifelong dream of building an "underwater city". Not as a fantasy, but as a realistic life drama.

(Source: Osamu Tezuka's Official Website, translated)
synonyms: Till a City Beneath the Sea is Built

title.native: 海底都市のできるまで

213373.description: Having been rejected by his crush, Audrey, Steve dons a black mask and a trench coat and starts working tirelessly towards solving cases, striving every day to win Audrey's heart.

213377.description: Music video for the song Mori no Kyoukai by the Nishirokugou Shounen Shoujo Gasshoudan that was featured on NHK's Minna no Uta program.

213378.description: Music video for the song Kaze no Uta by the NHK Tokyo Jidou Gasshoudan that was featured on NHK's Minna no Uta program.

213379.description:
Conflict becomes a thoroughbred?! The most relatable and dramatic conflict in the world, expressed through horse racing!

Racehorses named after various worries and conflicts that everyone faces engage in fierce races on the "racetrack" of the brain! A dramatic animation recreating the inner workings of the mind, dedicated to all the troubled modern people!

(Source: Asahi TV, translated)

213396.description:
Everyone, welcome back.

title.romaji: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni (Shin Anime)

213422.description:
It’s a familiar story: a popular high school student gives their plain friend a makeover and transforms their life. But this time, the path to a new life isn’t quite so straight and narrow. Kenshirou Midou has loved cosmetics all his life, keeping his obsession secret from almost everyone except for his childhood friend Hiura Mihate. One day, Kenshirou gets permission to practice applying makeup on Hiura, and the results are earth-shattering: Hiura’s appearance transforms from a plain, undersized boy to a pretty, petite girl, and Kenshirou discovers just how freeing it is to apply his passion! Yet he’s not the only one who finds the process liberating. Hiura likes the makeup, and the subsequent “dress-up” in feminine clothes, and decides to start wearing the girls’ uniform to school. Kenshirou doesn’t understand if he’s unlocked something in Hiura, or if he’s simply seeing a new side to his childhood buddy that he never noticed before. What are these feelings bubbling between them now–is this attraction truly new?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: I Think I Turned My Childhood Friend Into a Girl
I Turned My Childhood Friend (♂) Into a Girl

213426.description:
The anime centers on Kikkun, an extraterrestrial life form who came from a distant planet to invade Earth. But the invasion team members assigned in Japan finds the country comfortable, and now wants to protect Japan and Earth, forgetting their original motive.

(Source: Anime News Network)

213427.description: Lotte's snack brand Pie no Mi animated series which will be released on Lotte's official YouTube channel, with one episode released each month.

213436.description:
A young girl and her elder brother get a kind of magic chewing gum that can be transformed into anything they want. Then "Gum-gum" is sent down to keep an eye on them so that they won't abuse the magic gum. This is an animated film for small children depicting the adventures of these three characters.

(Source: Official site)

213437.description: Based on Takara Tomy's 2007 Choro Q Deck System toyline.

title.native: チョロQデッキシステム Qファイターズ!

213438.description: Fuji TV's series of short four-minute animation based on the four panel comic by Suzuki Yoshiji.

213457.description:
The earth of the distant future is covered in thick clouds, and the sun no longer shines. Plants wither, and oxygen is thin. To fight extinction, humankind has developed a technology that turns humans into plants, providing a small amount of oxygen. Is this process sustainable? Is it ethical? Toshiro Kamiya must consider these questions as he’s faced with a difficult choice—save his family or save himself.

Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of transfloration. Ready to give his body up for a payday, Kamiya is about to explore the limits of society’s waning humanity.

(Source: VIZ Media)

213458.description:
Behind the scenes of the serious competition in G1 races, you'll see the quirky and hilarious tactics played out by jockeys, horses, spectators, and trainers.

Don't miss the emotions of the people and horses who, with their complicated circumstances and personal feelings in mind, are determined to win the G1 and make the right predictions!

(Source: TV Asahi, translated, edited)

213459.description: The second season of Sorotani no Keibacchi.

213460.description: The third season of Sorotani no Keibacchi

Fate/Grand Order: You've Lost Ritsuka Fujimaru Season 2 Specials

title.romaji: Fate/Grand Order: Fujimaru Ritsuka wa Wakaranai Season 2 Specials

213462.description:
A thoroughbred named Mannenbilly, who's on a 30-race consecutive loss streak, is then rescued by a cat jockey?!

A trainer who takes care of Mannenbilly, an eccentric owner, and a cat jockey whose abilites are uncertain, but who is arguably the cutest in Japan, all aim for victory.

(Source: TV Asahi, translated)

title.native: 猫ジョッキー シーズン2

213464.description:
In lovely Broomstown, many cars with various jobs such as school buses, taxis, heavy equipment, tow trucks, cleaning cars, and mail delivery cars all live together. Large and small accidents occur every day in Broomstown, just like any other town. However, don't worry. The transforming rescue team is here to save any friends in distress anytime, anywhere!

The courageous and swift police car POLI, the powerful fire engine ROY, the intelligent AMBER, and the flying HELLY are all here to save the day!

(Source: Official Website)

213465.description:
The series follows Henry, who is a weak young adventurer trying to earn money for his younger sister. Henry's weak "Evasion" skill gets him kicked out of his party. However, he discovers a glitch that allows him to use "Evasion" to clip through walls and earn the first-time clear reward infinite times. By doing this, he rises from the bottom by boosting his stats and collecting rare items.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: I, The Weakest Player, Will Rise to the Top Using a "Wall-Clipping Glitch" – By Clipping Through Walls, I Earned the First-Time Clear Reward Infinite Times!

title.native: 最弱な僕は＜壁抜けバグ＞で成り上がる ～壁をすり抜けたら、初回クリア報酬を無限回収できました！～
title.romaji: Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru: Kabe wo Surinuketara Shokai Clear Houshuu wo Mugen Kaishuu Dekimashita!

213469.description:
Robotica. Machines made in the very likeness of humankind.

Robotica. Beings that exist to serve humanity.

Robotica. Created to bring people happiness.

The year is 2050, in a near-future Tokyo where dramatic leaps in information technology have promised every person a comfortable, content life within Shibuya.

Enter: A mysterious girl named Lily. Her very existence will shake the foundation of this world.

(Source: RE:BEL ROBOTICA Official Site, translated)

213477.description: The fifth season of Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e.

title.native: ようこそ実力至上主義の教室へ 5th Season
title.romaji: Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e 5th Season

213484.description:
Driven to the brink of despair, restaurant owner Ming forms an unlikely bond with the soul of the true King Lie after swallowing it to save his loved one. Bound together by fate, the two embark on a perilous journey to challenge the tyrant who has usurped the throne.

With only one hundred days to change their destiny, Ming uses his extraordinary memory to master long-lost magic, gathering allies and winning the support of the people along the way. As their strength grows, so does their resolve to overthrow a corrupt regime, reclaim the rightful king's throne, and restore peace to the realm.

(Source: Bilibili TV)

213486.description: The sixth season of You Shou Yan.

213497.description:
After the hero defeated the demon lord, the world is finally at peace... leaving the young Villager of Beginnerville in a bind! Without a demon lord to defeat, people have no need for potions and items...leaving Villager's item shop, The Nest, empty and lifeless. At this rate, Villager might have to close The Nest...! But then suddenly a mysterious girl appears and everything changes...

(Source: K MANGA)
synonyms: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop

213498.description:
Meet Juntaro. A Japanese fishing addict who was born and raised in what is perceived to be one of the roughest parts of Japan. It is through his lens where you can experience various parts of the world, their culture, and of course their food. He particularly loves to visit countries and cities that are also believed to be highly dangerous due to his personal belief that they will absolutely have delicious food. Because this was intended for a Japanese audience, you will also get to witness various worldviews unique to Japan alongside it all. There's just one problem:

He has extreme brainrot and views the world through a cute anime girl filter.

title.native: 鍋に弾丸を受けながら
title.romaji: Nabe ni Dangan wo Uke Nagara

title.romaji: Hokuto no Ken: Kenou-gun Zako-tachi no Banka Part 2

213507.description:
Sae, a high school girl who has trouble fitting in at the fancy "ojou-sama" private school, has a daily routine of playing mahjong on an app by herself during lunch break. She was playing in secret, thinking that such a hobby is unfashionable...? But one day, Chisei, the most popular girl in class, finds out about it! The two girls with opposite personalities, who normally wouldn't have anything in common, become playmates through mahjong...?

(Source: Nico Nico Seiga, translated)
synonyms: Good Day to You, How About a Game?

title.native: ごきげんよう、一局いかが？

213508.description: Music video directed by Buki for the song Ohitorisama by Sana Natori.

213509.description: Commemorative short animations between Eve and kawa made for the release of the song Underdog, set to the song Underdog.

213510.description:
Ten-year-old Kyoshi watches as a tramp transforms himself into a rich imposter at a stand-up bar in the Tamanoi district. Amusing tales from pre-war Tokyo based on the 1968 autobiographical manga Strange Tales of Terajima, written by Yuu Takita for the alternative magazine Garo.

(Source: The Anime Encyclopedia, edited)
synonyms: Ginnagashi: Strange Tales of Terajima District

title.native: 寺島町奇譚 ぎんながし

213511.description:
Jumping out of the cupboard, Chi-cha and Ikeho ask for Misuke's help, saying that they have to answer a quiz that the god Don-dan has given them to save their mother. Misuke then heads for a country in the south passing right through the cupboard.

(Source: Official Website)

Note: Second promotional film made to attract new students to Yahama's electronic organ classes.

213512.description:
Music video directed by goru for the song Warmthaholic by ZUTOMAYO.

Note: The song featured in this video also serves as the opening theme in the anime Aharen-san wa Hakarenai Season 2.

213514.description:
An online motion graphic series that provides a comedic interpretation of events that have occurred in conjunction with the anime.

Note: These episodes were originally posted on the series' official Twitter page on a weekly basis coinciding with the anime's broadcast, and were later included in the BD-BOX sets 1 through 3.

213515.description:
The story centers on Toruru, as he searches for his younger sister Haruru, through multiple dimensions with the help of the NaSuBi. This anime short features different directors for worlds Toruru visits:

Dimension One: Time Master directed by Tatsuyuki Tanaka (Tojin Kit, Digital Juice)

Researcher Ao and her apprentice Sango will try to get to the bottom of the mystery by analyzing the brains of the dead.

Ji Ziyue becomes entangled as a pawn in a political marriage, while Ye Fan finds himself surrounded by enemies and pressure from all sides. As the illegitimate daughter of a count and his maid, Katrina was born into miserable circumstances. And now that she's lost her mother, the treatment from her stepsister and stepmother the countess has only grown worse. One day, her stepsister receives a royal order to move to the northern outskirts due to her unseemly behavior at a recent party. There, she is to learn proper conduct under the tutelage of the resident prince, rumored to be a cruel man. Not wanting to subject her daughter to such punishment, the countess decides to send Katrina instead. Katrina arrives in the north shaking in fear. But contrary to the stories, the "merciless and cold-hearted" prince is kinder than she believed. Might the pure-hearted Katrina find love in the wintry countryside?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

213686.description:
Based on the erotic doujin game by Sensouya-san (戦争屋さん).

Coleus, a knight-in-training, attends a training academy. His new instructor turns out to be his childhood friend, Artel. "It's been a long time, Coleus." Coleus rejoices at reuniting with Artel, who has grown into a beautiful and strong woman. However, Artel quickly incurs the wrath of a fellow instructor, Lock. Lock, plotting to bring Artel down, seizes her wicked hands and robs her of her mental freedom. In front of her childhood friend, her voluptuous breasts are ravaged, and her virginity is taken. Lock's brutal acts escalate, and while Artel remains unconscious, her body, trained as a female knight, is transformed into that of a female. The joy of their reunion is the beginning of a nightmare. Although the members of the Dali Temple and the Yao Tian organization belong to different factions, they are all protecting Changan and pursuing their own sense of justice in their own ways.

Sikong Zhen discovers the mechanical beasts in the underground city and studies them privately. Wu Zetian notices something amiss and sends Shangguan Waner to investigate secretly, while the Yaotian organization also has its own plans…

Several forces intertwine, creating a turbulent undercurrent. Faced with the eventual outbreak of a common crisis, everyone, for the safety of Changan, overcomes all difficulties and works together to defeat the mechanical monsters, restoring peace to Changan.

"Capsules Project" is a collection of domestically produced animated short films created by a professional team with mature animation production experience. With the creative theme of "extreme emotion + independent theme," it does not restrict the creative form, exploring the possibilities of animation together with the team. The aim is to collaboratively create original short films with diverse styles and characteristics, and to help Chinese animators reach the world stage. "Miracle" represents transcending conventions and breaking through limitations to achieve extraordinary success, often accompanied by a sense of mystery that inspires awe and curiosity. The village still retains the strange custom of worshiping "paper brides". Tao Mengyan, who was chosen as the "paper bride", experienced a life-and-death experience in Zangling Village, and finally solved the mystery of her past life and learned the thousand-year-old historical truth of the "Zangzun" belief in Zangling Village.

Meiko, a beautiful, quiet, and academically gifted classmate, only shows her relaxed side in front of her childhood friend, Hiroki. Today, she comes to his room to hang out, and Hiroki can't help but glance at her body as she relaxes in light clothing. When she points it out, Hiroki blushes with embarrassment, but Meiko unexpectedly asks, "Well, do you want to touch me?" Their curiosity leads them to explore each other's bodies, which eventually escalates to sex...

Convinced of his false affection, she starts seeking him out on her own… Even though it’s her first time, she cums over and over just from being touched! With her actively seeking him out, he savors every inch of her body all day long, leaving nothing to be desired! No matter how many times he cums inside her, no matter how many times he makes her come, she feels nothing but happiness…!?

213740.description:
That boy could see sound. Luca, a boy with branches sprouting from his head, serves as a bugler in a mercenary company that thrives on war. Though surrounded by conflict, he dreams of becoming a musician. One day, amid the chaos of battle, a mysterious power awakens within him. His journey soon brings him into contact with the Pontiff, who stands at the pinnacle of the nation; Zoe, a fellow Branch-Born; and many others whose lives are intertwined with his own. Through these encounters, Luca's destiny begins to change in ways he could never have imagined. Arboral Year 1294—a battle that will determine the future is about to begin.

(Source: Producer Trailer)

Soara is a young orphan girl who was raised by knights and trained to battle the monsters that constantly attacked their kingdom. But by the time Soara is ready to join the fight herself, peace has been declared and her blade is no longer needed. Searching for a new home and a new purpose, Soara stumbles across Krik the dwarf, leader of the Monster Architects. Suddenly, instead of fighting monsters, Soara finds herself working with Krik to build comfortable homes for them! In the process, will she discover a new home and family for herself?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

213796.description:
Amelia, the kingdom of dragons with a monopoly on magical power, is once again invading other lands with the ferocious Queen Amelia at its head. Her eyes are set on Campusfellow, the small land of fire and iron, which at this rate will inevitably fall… For the sake of the country’s survival, Lord Bud Grace comes up with a last-resort plan—ally with the one known only as the Witch, the subject of countless terrifying tales. With the assassin Rollo, known as “Black Dog” and versed in every method of killing, at their disposal, they set out to enter an alliance with the first witch, also known as the Mirror Witch…

213805.description:
Koyuki, the isolated girl; Miki, the former school idol; Minato, the guy with no concept of personal space; and Youta, the gentle basketball player. Clumsy, frustrating, yet deeply endearing — this coming-of-age ensemble drama of crisscrossing hearts marches on.

As they grow closer, Koyuki and Minato begin to develop feelings for each other that go beyond mere friendship. Meanwhile, Youta finally confesses to Miki the feelings he's harbored for years. Some speak their hearts while others keep their emotions hidden, causing their paths — and their feelings for one another — to continuously cross and pass by…

(Source: Netflix)

In the nick of time, he is saved by an intriguing young lady named Leen, who, to his surprise, possesses the rare ability to tame any and all monsters! Now indebted to this unscrupulous monstermancer, Hakura decides to join her in her travels, the two of them arguing and bickering every step of the way. What has drawn them together, and what adventures await this unlikely pair?

Tokyo, 2029 -
Long believed to have vanished after the asteroid impact that caused their extinction, dinosaurs secretly survived by passing their DNA into humanity through interbreeding. Hidden among ordinary people, they now prey upon humans while living unnoticed within society.
Standing against them is a covert order of ninjas who wield Ryugesho, a special pigment infused with ancient memories. By applying this mysterious pigment, they awaken the powers of dinosaurs within themselves and fight back against the predators threatening humanity.
As the dinosaurs launch their campaign to wipe out humankind, the ninjas rise to stop them.

213928.description:
The future. Winter. Space travel is no longer a dream. A once-thriving film studio faces bankruptcy. The enormous compound, with structures ranging from the Great Sphinx of Giza to the Forbidden City, is now completely covered in snow and stripped of its former glory. Zha, a lonely janitor, tends to this forgotten place, with only a cat that used to perform in films for company. Running out of money, the studio owner gives him a VR headset as partial compensation. Zha is immediately drawn into the virtual world and embarks on a romantic journey with a female player who invites him on a trip to the moon. Meanwhile, the studio, which is about to close permanently, is temporarily brought back to life when a film crew arrives to shoot an alien invasion movie on the expansive backlot – with the studio’s actual destruction slated to be shot as the movie’s final showdown.

(Source: Berlinale Film Festival)

213929.description:
I want to wake up the princess who was put to sleep by a witch's curse… but there are seven of them! So it seems that I have to kiss...... seven girls! Now the princesses are awake, but the other people in the kingdom are still asleep...... Why? Is there more to breaking the curse than just a kiss or am I still missing something......?

Alec is the third prince of Rudbekia who wants to save the kingdom of Amaryllis and its seven princesses. In a country where only they are awake, they must work together to save everyone from the curse!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

213952.description:
"If you can really make me the Center...then we can get married."

Meet Mizuki Natsuno, the least popular member of the nationally acclaimed idol group, Melty Strawberry. She has an eternal fan in Koichi Okuta, who is always pouring heart and soul into supporting her. Normally, a fan would never get to interact with their idol beyond the stage. But one thing led to another, and Koichi now finds himself living together with Mizuki in his own house. He vows to make her the new Center of Melty Strawberry, sparking an unconventional tag-team between a devoted fan and his idol. Together, they attempt to elevate Mizuki's career from obscurity to stardom!

(Source: K MANGA)

213987.description:
Six years after the story first began as a manhua, Mo Lang and Bai Qi’s journey is finally making its way to the screen.

Spinning off as a series from the world of Scissor Seven, this new chapter takes us back to where another adventure began — with the meeting of two boys and the start of a thrilling journey.
